description: Audit scenario service.json files for fixed-port compliance with the route manifest

requirements.title: Scan scenario service.json for port field
requirements.description: For each route in the manifest, read the corresponding scenario's .vrooli/service.json and check that the UI port entry has a fixed 'port' field (not just a 'range')

requirements.title: Port value match verification
requirements.description: Verify that the fixed port in service.json matches the expected port in the route manifest. Report mismatches with both expected and actual values.

requirements.title: Missing scenario detection
requirements.description: Report when a manifest route references a scenario that doesn't exist on disk (scenario directory not found)

requirements.title: Audit result reporting
requirements.description: Return structured audit results per route: compliant, non-compliant (reason), or missing. Include summary counts.
